notes.title: Meandering Fiend Christmas Mazes
notes.content: [h1][b]Enjoy 5 new mazes set in a Christmas like environment. You can find it at the top of the road in Main World 1.[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Meandering Fiend Now Released
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GmDaysr.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Meandering Fiend is now released with the Christmas levels in their final stages of development for release. The guides to complete each level along with achievements should be bundled along side this update.[/b][/h1]
